welcome.title: Welcome to FlakeSecure
welcome.subtitle: Your secure biometric password manager. Login anywhere with just your fingerprint.
welcome.feature1: End-to-end encrypted : your passwords never touch our servers
welcome.feature2: Biometric authentication : Face ID & fingerprint support
welcome.feature3: Instant login : scan a QR code and you're in

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1: Open a login page in your browser. The FlakeSecure extension shows a QR code.
howItWorks.step2: Scan the QR code with this app and confirm with your biometrics.
howItWorks.step3: Your encrypted credentials are sent to the browser and you're logged in instantly.

extension.title: Browser Extension Required
extension.description: Install the FlakeSecure extension in your browser to enable QR-code login.
